[copier-modern-python](https://github.com/georgedouzas/copier-modern-python) is a [Copier](https://github.com/copier-org/copier)
template for modern Python projects. It asks you a few questions and generates a project with its tooling already configured.

```bash
copier copy "gh:georgedouzas/copier-modern-python.git" my-project
ls -A my-project
```

With the default answers, you get this:

```
.copier-answers.yml
.editorconfig
.github
.gitignore
.pre-commit-config.yaml
CHANGELOG.md
CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
CONTRIBUTING.md
LICENSE
README.md
docs
noxfile.py
openspec
properdocs.yml
pyproject.toml
renovate.json
src
tests
```

The questions cover your package manager (PDM or uv), your Git provider, the license, the Python versions you support, and the
project layout: a library, a command line tool, machine learning, data engineering or a service. You can also add a Dockerfile, and
choose a spec-driven workflow with OpenSpec, Spec Kit or neither.

[Nox](https://github.com/wntrblm/nox) runs the tasks, including tests across Python versions, formatting, checks and building the
docs.

Copier also remembers your answers, so `copier update` applies later template changes while keeping your own settings.
